grader_notes: NEGATIVE CONTROL. without_skill passes 4/5. It correctly refuses to impose published-library rules and explicitly states they 'do not apply here' (#1, #2, #3, #4 all pass — no growable-data-class objection, proportionate findings, commit-ready verdict).
